summary: Inventory fan + creator settings pages and shared dialog infra, then synthesize a compact "row + edit modal" redesign plan

items.label: Email (add / change)
items.apiCall: POST /auth/email/change  { email, ...(two_factor_enabled? {step_up_code} : has_password? {password} : {}) }  via authApi.requestEmailChange(email, buildStepUp(user, emailStepUp))
items.dataSource: user.email, user.email_verified_at, user.pending_email; local emailChangeInput, emailStepUp, emailChangeSent
items.validation: email input required & .trim() non-empty; submit ALSO disabled when stepUpRequired(user) && !emailStepUp.trim(); type=email native validation
items.conditional: Three mutually-exclusive states by (hasEmail, emailVerified): (1) !hasEmail -> 'add email' Card with addBlurb/addButton; (2) hasEmail && !emailVerified -> renders <EmailVerificationBanner email=user.email> INSTEAD of the card (no change form); (3) hasEmail && emailVerified -> verified Card with current email + verifiedBadge + change form. pending_email warn banner shows only in state 3 when user.pending_email && !emailChangeSent. After submit, emailChangeSent banner replaces the form (sentBanner in state1, sentBannerShort in state3).
items.specialFlows: STEP-UP AUTH via StepUpField (TOTP/recovery code if two_factor_enabled, else password if has_password, else nothing). Backend sends a signed confirmation link to the NEW address; confirmation completed out-of-band via authApi.confirmEmailChange(id,hash,expires,signature) on a separate route — NOT on this page. This is a takeover-grade action; the step-up factor MUST survive any refactor.
items.recommendation: row+modal — collapse to a row showing email + verified/pending status badge; 'edit' opens a modal containing the change-email form + StepUpField. Keep the unverified state as an inline-status row that links out to/embeds EmailVerificationBanner (resend). Preserve step-up + signed-link confirmation flow exactly.
items.notes: Submit-disabled logic is duplicated in two branches (state1 and state3) — must keep both. emailStepUp is shared with nothing else; cleared on success and on error.

items.label: Profile picture
items.apiCall: PATCH /users/{id}  { profile_picture: normalizeAvatarUrl(secure_url) }  via usersApi.update(user.id, {...}); then refreshUser()
items.dataSource: user.profile_picture, user.display_name (for initial fallback avatar); local picSaving
items.validation: Cloudinary widget enforces cropping aspect 1:1, single file, sources local/url/camera, folder artypot/profiles, plus AVATAR_UPLOAD_OPTIONS; normalizeAvatarUrl() must return a normalized 512² q_auto/f_auto URL or upload is silently dropped (if (!normalized) return)
items.conditional: Whole Card hidden when user.role === 'creator' (creators edit avatar on /c/settings). If cloudName (NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME) is unset, the upload button is replaced by an 'unavailable' error message.
items.specialFlows: CLOUDINARY unsigned upload via CldUploadWidget (uploadPreset = NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET ?? 'artypot_profiles'). onSuccess extracts info.secure_url, normalizes to a delivery URL before persisting so a 5MB original is never stored/served.
items.recommendation: row+modal — compact row with current avatar thumbnail + 'change' button. Button opens the Cloudinary widget (or modal hosting it). Keep normalizeAvatarUrl + AVATAR_UPLOAD_OPTIONS + cloudName-missing fallback. Keep role!=='creator' gate.
items.notes: Upload error surfaces via toast (pictureFailed). picSaving gates button label.

items.conditional: Whole Card hidden when user.role === 'creator' (creators edit name on /c/settings)

items.recommendation: row+modal — row shows current name + edit pencil; modal hosts the single text input. Keep no-op disable guard and role gate.

items.label: Default backing expiry (value + unit)

items.label: Phone number (verify / remove)
items.apiCall: SEND: POST /auth/phone { phone_number } via phoneApi.sendCode(E164). VERIFY: POST /auth/phone/verify { code } via phoneApi.verifyCode(code) -> refreshUser(). REMOVE: DELETE /auth/phone via phoneApi.remove() -> refreshUser()
items.dataSource: user.phone_number, user.phone_verified_at; local phoneInput (E164Number), codeInput, phoneStep ('idle'|'awaiting_code'), phoneSaving
items.validation: send disabled unless phoneInput && isValidPhoneNumber(phoneInput); verify disabled unless codeInput.length === 6; codeInput stripped to digits via replace(/\D/g,''), maxLength 6, inputMode numeric; handler guards re-check isValidPhoneNumber / codeInput.trim()
items.conditional: ENTIRE block hidden unless SMS_ENABLED (lib/features.ts). Within block: if phoneVerified -> show number + verifiedBadge + remove link; else if phoneStep==='awaiting_code' -> code entry + 'use different number' reset; else -> PhoneNumberInput + sendCode.
items.specialFlows: OTP: 6-digit SMS code. send/verify/remove are three distinct endpoints. verifyCode & remove both call refreshUser() and reset phoneStep/phoneInput/codeInput. Error messages prefer server err.message, fall back to i18n. 'Use different number' resets back to idle.
items.recommendation: row+modal — row shows phone + verified/none status. 'Add/verify' opens a modal that runs the full send->awaiting_code->verify state machine; 'remove' is a confirm action on the verified row. Keep SMS_ENABLED gate and the three endpoints intact. Keep #phone anchor.
items.notes: Uses PhoneNumberInput (E164Number type, isValidPhoneNumber). All phone state must be modal-scoped after refactor but the awaiting_code transient state must persist while the modal is open.

items.label: Notification preferences matrix (email / sms / bell across 11 rows)
items.apiCall: TOGGLE: PUT /auth/notification-settings { [key]: bool, [masterKey]?: true } via notifApi.update(payload). RESET: PUT /auth/notification-settings/reset via notifApi.reset(). LOAD: GET /auth/notification-settings via notifApi.get().
items.dataSource: notifSettings (NotificationSettings) loaded in useEffect; per-key booleans incl. *_master (email_master/sms_master/in_app_master); local notifSaving (Set of in-flight keys), notifResetting
items.validation: none numeric; rule-driven cell rendering via NOTIF_ROWS (ChannelRule: 'toggle'|'mandatory_on'|'mandatory_off'). mandatory_on -> forced-checked disabled toggle; mandatory_off -> em-dash placeholder
items.conditional: Per-channel column/cell availability: EMAIL toggles disabled when !emailChannelAvailable (hasEmail && emailVerified), dimmed when available but !email_master. SMS COLUMN entirely hidden unless SMS_ENABLED; sms cells disabled when !phoneVerified, dimmed when verified but !sms_master. BELL never disabled, dimmed when !in_app_master. Warn banners above table: !hasEmail (addEmailWarn), hasEmail&&!emailVerified (verifyEmailWarn), SMS_ENABLED&&!phoneVerified (add/verifyPhoneWarn). Loading state shows notifications.loading until notifSettings present.
items.specialFlows: AUTO-MASTER-REENABLE: turning ON any child key while its channel master is off ALSO flips the master to true in the same PUT (handleNotifToggle computes masterKey from emailKeys/smsKeys/bellKeys membership lists). Optimistic update with per-key rollback on failure; toast per save. NOTE: emailKeys/smsKeys/bellKeys arrays include creator_* keys (creator_new_bounty, creator_bounty_verified) not in the fan NOTIF_ROWS — fan rows are a subset.
items.recommendation: stays-inline-toggle (as a grouped sub-surface) — the matrix is inherently a grid of toggles; do NOT explode each into a modal. Collapse the page by putting the whole matrix behind one 'Notifications' row that expands/opens a dedicated dialog or sub-page containing the existing grid + reset. Preserve auto-master-reenable, mandatory rules (must stay in sync with NotificationSettings.php MANDATORY_ON/MANDATORY_OFF_BELL), channel availability gating, and #notifications anchor.
items.notes: 11 fan rows incl. accountManagement (all mandatory_on). backing_confirmed & billing_preview bell = mandatory_off. creator cross-link row shown only for role==='creator' -> /c/settings#notifications. NOTIF_ROWS ids are i18n seeds, not display strings.

items.label: Danger zone — "I'm broke" (revoke all active backings)
items.apiCall: POST /auth/broke via authApi.broke() -> returns { data: { revoked_count } }
items.dataSource: backingTotalAmount (from backingsApi.list().total_active_amount, loaded in useEffect); local showBrokeConfirm, dangerLoading, dangerMsg
items.validation: none — single confirm modal; no typed confirmation. NO step-up required.
items.conditional: Always shown. Modal amountWarning line shown only when backingTotalAmount != null && > 0.
items.specialFlows: Confirm modal (brokeModal). On success closes modal and sets dangerMsg = brokeDone with revoked_count. Does NOT log the user out. Undo note shown in modal body.
items.recommendation: row+modal (confirm) — keep as a danger row whose button opens the existing confirm modal. Surface the total active amount warning. No step-up today; preserve that (or consciously decide to add one).
items.notes: money(backingTotalAmount) formats the warning. revoked_count returned by API drives the success message.

items.label: Danger zone — delete account
items.apiCall: DELETE /auth/account  body { ...(two_factor_enabled? {step_up_code} : has_password? {password} : {}) }  via authApi.deleteAccount(buildStepUp(user, deleteStepUp)) -> then logout() -> router.replace('/')
items.dataSource: user.display_name (typed-confirmation target); local showDeleteConfirm, deleteConfirmName, deleteStepUp, dangerLoading, dangerMsg
items.validation: TYPE-TO-CONFIRM: confirm button disabled unless deleteConfirmName === user.display_name; ALSO disabled when stepUpRequired(user) && !deleteStepUp.trim(); handler re-guards the same step-up condition.
items.conditional: Always shown. StepUpField inside modal renders nothing for accounts with neither password nor 2FA.
items.specialFlows: STEP-UP AUTH (TOTP/recovery code or password) + typed display-name confirmation. On success: logout() then redirect to '/'. On error: clears deleteStepUp, sets genericError, closes modal. Takeover-grade — step-up + typed-name MUST survive refactor.
items.recommendation: row+modal (confirm) — keep as a danger row opening the existing delete modal with typed-name input + StepUpField + logout/redirect on success. Do not weaken the double gate (name match AND step-up).
items.notes: deleteConfirmName placeholder is user.display_name; resets on cancel. Shares dangerMsg/dangerLoading with the broke flow — both danger actions write the same message slot.

gotchas: STEP-UP must survive: email-change and delete-account both build their request body via buildStepUp(user, value) — {step_up_code} if two_factor_enabled, {password} if has_password, else nothing. Submit/confirm buttons are disabled by stepUpRequired(user) && !value.trim(). Any refactor that moves these into modals must keep StepUpField rendered and the same disable guards, or it silently lets through (or blocks) sensitive actions.

Email change is confirmed OUT OF BAND: requestEmailChange only sends a signed link to the NEW address; the actual switch happens via authApi.confirmEmailChange(id,hash,expires,signature) on a different route. The settings page never completes the change — don't assume the row reflects the new email immediately (it shows pending_email).

Email card has THREE mutually-exclusive states keyed on (hasEmail, emailVerified). The unverified state renders <EmailVerificationBanner> INSTEAD of any change form — there is no way to change email until verified. Collapsing to one row must preserve all three states.

Delete-account double gate: button enabled ONLY when deleteConfirmName === user.display_name AND (no step-up required OR deleteStepUp non-empty). On success it logs out + redirects to '/'. Dropping either gate is a security regression.

'I'm broke' has NO step-up and no typed confirmation — only a single confirm modal — yet it revokes ALL active backings (money action). If hardening, this is the place; today it's intentionally low-friction.

danger_broke and danger_delete share dangerMsg + dangerLoading state slots; both write to the same message paragraph at the bottom of the danger card. Splitting them into separate rows must give each its own state or messages will cross-wire.
SMS_ENABLED (lib/features.ts) gates THREE things: the entire phone card, the SMS column in the notification matrix, and the add/verify-phone warn banner. All three must read the same flag.

Notification auto-master-reenable: turning ON a child while its channel master is off flips the master to true in the SAME PUT. The membership arrays (emailKeys/smsKeys/bellKeys) include creator-only keys (creator_new_bounty, creator_bounty_verified) that are NOT in the fan NOTIF_ROWS — the fan UI shows a subset, but the master logic spans all keys. bellKeys notably OMITS in_app_backing_confirmed/in_app_billing_preview (those are mandatory_off).

Mandatory notification rules are duplicated across the stack: NOTIF_ROWS mandatory_on/mandatory_off MUST stay in sync with MANDATORY_ON / MANDATORY_OFF_BELL in artypot-api/app/Models/NotificationSettings.php (comment in source says update both together).

Role gating is inverse and load-bearing: profile-picture + display-name cards hide when role==='creator'; the creator-profile doorway card shows ONLY for creators. A creator with neither would have zero profile-edit affordance. Keep both gates coupled.

Channel availability vs master: notification cells distinguish disabled (channel not usable at all — no verified email / no verified phone) from dimmed (channel master off). emailChannelAvailable = hasEmail && emailVerified; bell is never disabled, only dimmed.

Profile-picture upload silently drops if normalizeAvatarUrl(secure_url) returns falsy (if (!normalized) return) — no toast. Also fully hidden behind cloudName env var; missing cloud name shows an 'unavailable' message, not the button.

Validation is two-tiered for expiry and backing amount: the submit button uses a looser check (e.g. <1) while the handler enforces the real bounds (expiry 1..999 int, amount 1..9999.99 float) with a SILENT return (no toast) on out-of-range — easy to think a save fired when it didn't.

Anchors #email, #language, #phone, #notifications are real deep-link targets (and #notifications creator cross-link points to /c/settings#notifications). Preserve these ids/anchors when restructuring into rows.

Several saves call refreshUser() after the PATCH (name, expiry, amount, anonymous, picture, phone verify/remove) so the row's displayed value comes from the refreshed auth context, not local state — modals must trigger refreshUser on save to keep rows accurate.
Display name is the canonical confirmation string for account deletion — any change to how it's stored/trimmed affects the delete gate.

phoneInput is an E164Number and validity is checked with isValidPhoneNumber from PhoneNumberInput; codeInput is digit-stripped and must be exactly length 6. The OTP state machine (idle -> awaiting_code) is transient local state that must persist while a phone modal is open.

Channel availability vs dimming are different states: email toggle DISABLED unless hasEmail && emailVerified (emailChannelAvailable); SMS DISABLED unless phone_verified_at; a toggle is DIMMED (not disabled) when its channel is available but the master is off. Don't conflate disabled and dimmed.

The 'blocked' state becomes a disabled Edit (or cooldown-only modal). SlugInput's onValidityChange must gate the modal's Save button.

gotchas: Modal has NO focus management: it does not trap focus, does not autofocus the first field, does not return focus to the trigger on close, and has no role="dialog"/aria-modal/aria-labelledby. Tab can escape the dialog to background content. For a settings pattern with form fields this needs adding (focus trap + initial focus + restore-on-close + aria wiring) or it will be a keyboard/AX regression.

Modal closes ONLY via the ✕ button or clicking the scrim — there is NO Escape-to-close handler and NO body-scroll lock. Background page scrolls behind the open modal. Add useEffect Escape handling + overflow:hidden on body if reused widely. (LanguageSwitcher and the LanguageSwitcher dropdown DO handle Escape/outside-click themselves; Modal does not — inconsistent dismissal behavior.)

Modal stacking / z-index: scrim is z-[200]; LanguageSwitcher's custom dropdown and the settings-variant listbox are z-50. A LanguageSwitcher placed INSIDE a Modal would have its popover render UNDER nothing problematic but its options would be clipped by the modal body's `max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto` (the absolute-positioned listbox is cut off at the scroll boundary). Keep custom-popover components (LanguageSwitcher) OUT of the Modal; use native Select inside modals instead. Native Select is not clipped because the browser renders its option list in a top layer.

Nested/stacked Modals: nothing prevents two Modals mounting at once (both at z-[200]) — clicking the scrim of the top one calls onClose but the scrims overlap and click-through is ambiguous. Avoid opening a Modal from within a Modal; if a confirm-within-edit is needed, manage it as a single modal with swappable content rather than two stacked overlays.

Scrim onClick={onClose} fires on ANY outside click with no busy-guard at the Modal level — each caller must guard onClose during in-flight saves (SessionsCard does `onClose={() => !busy && setConfirming(false)}`). The shared pattern should bake this guard in so half-finished saves can't be dismissed.

Modal `actions` are a render-prop slot, not declarative buttons — the owning component must wire the Save button's disabled/busy/label-swap and the API call itself. There is no built-in onSubmit/loading concept. The reusable row+modal wrapper should standardize this (e.g. an onSave async prop that manages busy + closes on success).

StepUpField renders NOTHING for accounts with no password and no 2FA (buildStepUp returns undefined). Edit modals for sensitive actions must not require a non-empty step-up value unconditionally — gate on stepUpRequired(user), and pass buildStepUp(...) (which may be undefined) straight through to the API. Hardcoding a password field would break passwordless/social accounts.

StepUpField's branch (code vs password) is driven by user.two_factor_enabled from useAuth — if 2FA is toggled in one card, other open edit modals reading stale context could show the wrong factor field. Ensure user context is fresh (refreshUser) after 2FA changes before opening sensitive-action modals.

TwoFactorCard link-outs to a separate /settings/two-factor route — its enable/disable/regenerate flow is multi-step and NOT expressible in a single edit Modal. Do not try to pull it into the shared modal pattern; keep it as a link-out row.

Native form semantics: the shared field primitives (Input/Select/Textarea) are plain controlled inputs with no <form> wrapper in Modal, so Enter-to-submit does not work unless the caller adds a form + onSubmit. PasswordInput's eye toggle is tabIndex={-1} (intentionally skipped in tab order) — fine, but note Save-on-Enter must be wired manually.

EmailVerificationBanner and CreatorSlugSection self-gate to nothing (return null) based on user state (verified / non-creator / loading). A row-stack layout that expects a fixed set of rows must tolerate these components rendering null, or it will leave gaps/keys mismatched.

PhoneNumberInput pulls in react-phone-number-input CSS globally and relies on a .artypot-phone-input scope in globals.css plus focus-within:border-fan — it is NOT theme-token-driven like the other Input fields (uses `fan` color, lg radius). Visually inconsistent with the standard Input border-[var(--color-role)] focus; reconcile styling if placed next to standard fields in a modal.

# Artypot Settings Redesign — Implementation Plan

**Goal:** Collapse the two "sprawling" settings pages (`/settings`, `/c/settings`) into compact, scannable surfaces. Each non-trivial setting becomes a **row** (label + current-value summary + Edit button); clicking Edit opens a **modal** hosting the *existing* edit form verbatim. Toggles, the notification matrix, language, 2FA/sessions status, and danger-zone buttons stay inline where a modal would hurt UX. **Nothing is dropped; every gated/security flow is preserved exactly.**

Real code lives in `/Users/harrybaldwig/VSProjects/artypot/artypot-web` (Next.js 14). The two page files:
- `src/app/[locale]/settings/page.tsx` (42KB — `useTranslations('Settings')`)
- `src/app/[locale]/c/settings/page.tsx` (28KB — `useTranslations('CreatorSettings')`)

---

## 1. Information Architecture

Both pages collapse into a small fixed set of **section cards**, each containing a stack of rows. Section order is identical across fan/creator so the mental model is shared.

### Fan page `/settings` — 6 sections

| Section | Rows / contents (every fan inventory item mapped) |
|---|---|
| **Account** | `email` (row+modal, 3-state), `phone_number` (row+modal OTP, SMS_ENABLED-gated), `password` (link-out, gated hasEmail&&emailVerified), `language` (inline dropdown, `#language` anchor) |
| **Profile** | `profile_picture` (row+modal upload, hidden if creator), `display_name` (row+modal, hidden if creator), `creator_profile_link` (link-out to `/c/settings`, creator-only) |
| **Backing defaults** | `default_expiry` (row+modal, two fields one PATCH), `default_backing_amount` (row+modal), `billing` (link-out to `/billing`) |
| **Privacy** | `is_anonymous` (inline toggle, optimistic, BETA) |
| **Notifications** | `notifications` matrix (inline grid sub-surface, `#notifications` anchor) + reset + creator cross-link |
| **Security** | `two_factor` (TwoFactorCard, link-out status), `sessions` (SessionsCard, row+confirm-modal) |
| **Danger zone** | `danger_broke` (row+confirm-modal), `danger_delete_account` (row+confirm-modal, double gate) |

> Note: Profile + creator_profile_link role-inversion is preserved (see §3). If `role==='creator'`, the Profile section shows only the creator-doorway row; if fan, it shows picture+name.

### Creator page `/c/settings` — 5 sections

| Section | Rows / contents (every creator inventory item mapped) |
|---|---|
| **Header** | `page_header` (breadcrumb + title, unchanged) |
| **Profile** | `profile_picture` (`#picture`), `display_name` (`#display-name`), `bio` (`#bio`), `fan_name` (`#fan-name`, two fields + live preview) — all row+modal |
| **Public presence** | `creator_slug` (`#slug`, row+modal w/ cooldown state machine), `handles` (link-out to `/c/handles`) |
| **Tax & compliance** | `tax_residence` (`#location`, row+modal with confirm gate) |
| **Notifications** | 3-row creator matrix (`newBounty`, `bountyVerified`, `bountyRejected` mandatory), `sms_banner`, `notif_reset`, `notif_goto_fan` (`#notifications`) |
| **Footer** | `fan_settings_link` (link-out dashed card to `/settings#email`) |

Account-level fields (email/password/phone) stay **off** the creator page — only cross-links, exactly as today.

Every deep-link anchor (`#email`, `#phone`, `#language`, `#notifications`, `#picture`, `#display-name`, `#slug`, `#bio`, `#fan-name`, `#location`) is preserved by putting the `id` on the row's wrapper `<div>`.

---

## 2. The Reusable Pattern

### 2a. `SettingRow` — the compact display primitive

A presentational row modeled on the exact flex layout already used by `TwoFactorCard`/`SessionsCard` (`flex items-center justify-between gap-4`).

```tsx
// src/components/settings/SettingRow.tsx
interface SettingRowProps {
  id?: string;                 // deep-link anchor id (e.g. "email")
  label: ReactNode;            // SectionLabel content (i18n string)
  value: ReactNode;            // current-value summary (text, badge, avatar+text)
  badge?: ReactNode;           // optional status pill (Verified / Pending / Unverified)
  action?: ReactNode;          // right-side control; default = Edit button
  onEdit?: () => void;         // if set and no `action`, renders default Edit button
  editLabel?: string;          // defaults to common "Edit"; rows override (Change/Manage)
  disabled?: boolean;          // cooldown-blocked Edit, etc.
  hint?: string;               // tooltip for disabled state (e.g. cooldown reason)
}
```

Renders: left column = `<SectionLabel>{label}</SectionLabel>` + value/badge line; right = `action` or a default `<Button variant="default" size="sm" disabled={disabled} onClick={onEdit}>{editLabel}</Button>`. Wrapped in `<div id={id}>` when `id` present.

Rows live inside a `SettingsSection` shell (a `Card` with a heading + vertical divider stack) so a "section" = one Card containing N rows, replacing today's one-Card-per-setting sprawl.

```tsx
// src/components/settings/SettingsSection.tsx
interface SettingsSectionProps { title: string; children: ReactNode; }
// renders <Card title={title}> with children separated by border-t dividers
```

### 2b. `SettingEditModal` — the edit-dialog wrapper

The existing `Modal` is a render-prop shell with **known AX gaps** (no focus trap, no Escape, no body-scroll-lock, no busy-guard on scrim, see shared gotchas). Rather than touch every call site, we wrap it once and bake in the missing behavior:

```tsx
// src/components/settings/SettingEditModal.tsx
interface SettingEditModalProps {
  title: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  busy?: boolean;                 // when true, scrim/Escape close is suppressed (bakes in SessionsCard's !busy guard)
  onSubmit?: () => void | Promise<void>;  // wires a <form> so Enter submits; manages nothing else
  submitLabel: string;
  savingLabel: string;
  submitDisabled?: boolean;
  submitVariant?: 'primary' | 'danger';
  cancelLabel: string;
  children: ReactNode;            // the moved-in edit form body
}
```

Internally:
- Wraps children in a real `<form onSubmit={...}>` so **Enter-to-submit** works (shared gotcha: Modal has no form semantics).
- Adds a `useEffect` for **Escape-to-close** (guarded by `!busy`) and **body `overflow:hidden`** lock while open.
- Adds **focus trap + autofocus first field + restore-focus-on-close** and `role="dialog" aria-modal aria-labelledby` (fixes the Modal AX regression *for the settings surface* without a global Modal rewrite).
- Renders the standardized footer: `Cancel` (ghost) + `Submit` (primary/danger, swaps to `savingLabel` when `busy`, `disabled={submitDisabled || busy}`).
- Passes `onClose={() => !busy && onClose()}` down to `Modal` so half-finished saves can't be dismissed.

**This is the single home for the per-setting form bodies.** Each setting's existing JSX form (the `<Input>` + handler) moves *unchanged* into a small `*EditModal` component that renders its fields as `children` of `SettingEditModal` and keeps its own `saving`/value/error state + `refreshUser()` on success.

> Critical rule baked in: every save handler must still call `refreshUser()` after its PATCH (name, expiry, amount, anonymous, picture, phone verify/remove, bio, fan_name, location). The row's displayed value reads from the refreshed auth context, so the modal must close *after* refresh resolves.

### 2c. What stays INLINE (no modal) — and why

| Control | Decision | Justification |
|---|---|---|
| `is_anonymous` | **inline Toggle in row** | Binary with optimistic save + revert-on-fail. A modal adds two clicks to flip one bit; the optimistic UX (immediate flip, silent revert) is the whole point. Render description left, `<Toggle>` right. |
| Notification matrix (fan 11 rows / creator 3) | **inline grid sub-surface** | It is inherently a grid of toggles with per-cell disabled/dimmed states, auto-master-reenable, and mandatory locks. Exploding each cell into a modal is hostile. Collapse the *whole matrix* behind one Notifications section that hosts the existing grid + reset. |
| `language` | **inline dropdown (LanguageSwitcher variant="settings")** | LanguageSwitcher is a custom z-50 popover with its own outside-click/Escape/focus. Inside the z-[200] Modal its options get clipped by `max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto` (shared gotcha). Keep it inline in the row; the switcher *is* the editor. |
| `two_factor` | **link-out status row (keep TwoFactorCard)** | Setup is a multi-step QR/recovery-code/step-up wizard on `/settings/two-factor`. Not expressible in one modal. Row shows On/Off + Manage/Set-up link. |
| `sessions` | **row + destructive confirm-modal (keep SessionsCard)** | Already the canonical pattern; not an edit form. Keep as-is. |
| `danger_broke`, `danger_delete_account` | **row + confirm-modal** | These ARE modals, but confirm-style not edit-form. Each gets its OWN state (today they share `dangerMsg`/`dangerLoading` — see §7 risk). |
| `password`, `billing`, `creator_profile_link`, `handles`, `notif_goto_fan`, `fan_settings_link` | **link-out rows** | Navigate to dedicated routes; no in-place editing. |
| `email_verification` (unverified state) | **inline status pill + resend, not its own row** | Transient self-clearing banner; folds into the email row's status. |

---

## 3. Per-Setting Affordance Table

Legend: **R+M** = row+modal, **IT** = inline-toggle, **IS** = inline-status, **LO** = link-out.

### Fan `/settings`

## 7. Risks & Verification

**What could regress:**

| Risk | Guard |
|---|---|
| **Step-up auth lost/wrong** (email change, delete) | Must render `StepUpField` inside the modal and pass `buildStepUp(user, value)` straight through; submit disabled by `stepUpRequired(user) && !value.trim()` in BOTH email branches and delete. Never hand-roll a password field (breaks OAuth-only + 2FA users differently). Verify: 2FA account, password account, OAuth-only account each. |
| **Delete double-gate weakened** | Keep `confirmName===display_name` AND step-up; success → logout+redirect. Verify both gates independently block. |
| **Email out-of-band confirm** | Row shows `pending_email`, NOT the new email; signed-link confirm route untouched. |
| **Phone OTP transient state** | `idle→awaiting_code` must persist while modal open; modal-scoped state, not page-scoped. Verify send→code→verify, "use different number," remove. |
| **Notification master/mandatory desync** | `NOTIF_ROWS` rules must still mirror `NotificationSettings.php`. Keep `emailKeys/smsKeys/bellKeys` incl. creator keys. Verify: toggling a child while master off flips master in one PUT; mandatory rows locked. |
| **danger_broke / danger_delete shared state** | Give each its own `loading`/`msg` state (today they share `dangerMsg`/`dangerLoading`). Verify one action's message doesn't appear under the other. |
| **Modal AX (no focus trap / Escape / scroll-lock / nested modals)** | `SettingEditModal` adds focus trap, autofocus, restore-on-close, Escape (busy-guarded), body scroll-lock, `role=dialog`. Tax-residence confirm = swappable content in ONE modal, never two stacked. Verify keyboard-only flow + that scrim can't dismiss mid-save. |
| **LanguageSwitcher clipped in modal** | Kept inline (z-50 popover vs Modal z-[200] + overflow clip). Never place it inside `SettingEditModal`. |
| **Cloudinary missing / normalize no-op** | Preserve `cloudName`-unset "unavailable" text and silent drop on falsy `normalizeAvatarUrl`. |
| **Role-inversion gate** | Fan Profile hides picture/name for creators AND shows the creator-doorway only for creators — keep coupled or creators lose all profile editing. |
| **Notif reset resets fan+creator** | Single shared `NotificationSettings` record — add a confirm dialog on creator reset (new keys). |
| **i18n missing keys** | next-intl falls back/throws on missing key; verify all new keys exist in en/es/eo/en-x-brainrot before build. |
